advice.description: Exactly one of the two: conflict, when every option is excluded or two recorded decisions contradict each other on the question, nothing decided; decision, otherwise, decided.

anyOf.description: conflict: the record is at fault; no record, and the step stops.

reason.description: The records that collide, each quoted, or for each option the rule it would change. Not empty.

anyOf.description: decision: the record, appended unedited to the project's decisions record.

asked_by.description: Who asked, as the question file states it.

question.description: The question, as the question file states it.

options.description: The options, as the question file states them.

why.description: Why it is excluded: the rule it would change, or what settles the question against it.

rests_on.description: Each source the answer rests on: a recorded decision as its document and rule or record (e.g. ADR-002 rule 3, D-3, AGENTS.md), code as its file. The one entry "none" when no source bears on the question.

follow_ups.description: What the decision leaves to do, one per entry. A follow-up that changes code names the test that proves it.
